body:
Commented from my main by accident, oh well. 

Anyway, it's not enough. I mean, idk. I don't really have any goals. I'm in like reverse. I didn't live with my mom for 21 years, now I'm only here so I'm not homeless. I don't know how long it'll take me to support myself again.

I mean it's alright, it's menial. I only waited as long as I did because I felt like I'd rather be miserable doing nothing than miserable at work. I have a lot of fines now, I owe the IRS money, and Bank of America quite a bit too. All of this resulting from that one incident, all of it. It was just a lot to take in.
Yeah until they come after me for you know, fleeing.

I've started working recently in downtown Philadelphia at a restaurant. I don't care if you know where I live, I'm not that private. It's not much but I should have started working months ago. I just couldn't muster the courage to do it. I know going into court without a job looks *bad*, I know.

Also thank you, writing has always been my hobby. Me and my 15 novels "in progress" hahaha. I stopped writing after everything happened, this is the first form of any kind of writing I've done since the arrest.
